title: 4.1.6 Print Shop (Q1 Synthesis)
description: Q1 synthesis: a console-only pricing and queue tool for the class printers. Arrays of objects, functions, sorting, save/load, and your own tests.

steps.title: Store at least 5 orders as objects in an array
steps.instructions: Each order needs name, width, height, depth, filament, and priority.

steps.title: priceOf(order) — grams x cost/gram + machine time
fitsInVolume(order, maxW, maxH, maxD) — three parameters
Save and load the queue with localStorage + JSON
Main program prints one formatted verdict
Three manual tests printing PASS or FAIL
README, comments, and style guide compliance
steps.instructions: Appendix A applies. The README says what the tool does and how to run it, and — per Appendix D — what changed from your A4.1.0 chart and why.

requirements.title: Five orders stored
requirements.description: At least five objects with a priority field

requirements.title: estimateHours function
requirements.description: Estimates print time from the order's volume

requirements.title: priceOf function
requirements.description: Calculates a price from filament grams and machine time

requirements.title: Saves and loads with localStorage + JSON
Prints a formatted verdict
requirements.description: A console.log that reports money and queue length together

requirements.title: Tests report PASS or FAIL
requirements.description: A check that prints PASS when it matches the known answer and FAIL when it does not. The checker cannot count your tests — three is on you, and the teacher reads for it.
